_matrixAnalyse: Python conversion data is scattered across small volumes but consistent in direction. 'Python' itself (21 clk, CVR 9.5% and 17 clk, CVR 11.8%) converts well — broad intent with a good match to the page. 'Python certification' (6 clk, CVR 16.7% and 19 clk, CVR 5.3%) is a strong signal : the audience wants a recognised output, not just knowledge. 'Learn Python free' (13 clk, CVR 7.7%) converts — surprisingly, the 'free' qualifier does not repel conversions here, suggesting the page successfully redirects the intent. Pattern B : 'Python for beginners' (9 clk + 7 clk, CVR 0%) — the beginner label attracts clicks but not conversions. The page should lead with outcomes, not difficulty level.
